I am an old woman farming my small piece of land here on the slopes of Kilimanjaro. My plot is only a third of a hectare and I grow beans together with other crops — beans do not need much fertilizer because they fix their own nitrogen from the air, so I save my little money for other things. I will put some manure from my animals on the plot because the soil needs feeding, and I will use seeds I saved from last harvest since improved bean seeds are expensive and hard to find. The rains here on the mountain are usually enough, so I do not irrigate, and I will do most of the work myself with help from family.
